lecture_title: Invariant Laws, Four-Vectors, and the Field Tensor

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: Shows all three coordinate-equality conditions as the collision rule is rewritten as spatial coincidence.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: We can write it that the particle collides only if r one is equal to r two.

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The lecturer has stepped away after completing both the indexed Lorentz law and its column-vector matrix form.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Just think of it as matrix multiplication or manipulation of indices.

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Shows the upper and lower component lists, metric matrix, and invariant contraction after the board corrections.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This is very much like taking the x vector and computing the proper length or proper time.
assets.caption_hint: Metric, index lowering, and invariant norm

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Shows both squared sums and differences at the point where their cross terms establish the invariant inner product.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This is A times A plus B times B minus twice A times B.
assets.caption_hint: Polarization argument for the four-vector inner product

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Provides an unobstructed view of the proper-time division and the derivation of dt/dtau.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Now we know the relationship between the spatial components of the four velocity and ordinary velocity.

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: The full pre-relativistic Lorentz force law is visible without lecturer occlusion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: There is no velocity in here; there is a velocity in here.
assets.caption_hint: Electric and magnetic terms in the Lorentz force

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Shows the transformation of each vector and the two-Lorentz-matrix law for their rank-two product.

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed antisymmetric array with a zero diagonal and paired opposite-sign entries.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: When you reflect it about the diagonal, it changes sign.
assets.caption_hint: Component structure of an antisymmetric tensor

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: Shows the completed electromagnetic matrix with all electric and magnetic entries in the lecture's spatial-first order.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: It has six independent components and fills out a four by four matrix.

assets.name: lecture_06_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: The cyclic F12, F23, and F31 magnetic-component relations are visible together and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The others follow just by cycling the numbers from one to two to three.
assets.caption_hint: Cyclic magnetic components of the field tensor
